div.l: For thow a wedewe hadde not a scho
So plesaunt was his inprincipio
Ȝit wolde he haue a ferthyng er he wente
His purchas was wel betyr than hese rente
And rage he couthe as it were ryȝt a whelp
In louedayis there couthe he mekil help
For there he was not lik a cloysterer
With a thredbare kope as is a scholerscoler scholer scoler
But he was lik a m ay a y stir or a pope
Of double worstede was hese semeli kope
Thaᵗ roıı̄unded as a belle / out of the presse
Sūmwhat he lipsede for hese wantoūnesse
To make hese engelisch swete vp on his tunge
And in hese harpȳnge whan that he hadde sūnge
Hese eyȝyyn twȳnkeledyn in hese hed aryȝt
As don the sterrys / in the frosty nyght
This worthi limytoᵘur / was clepid hobert
A marchaıı̄unt was there with a forkede berdMarchaıı̄unt
In motle an heigh on horse he sat
Vp on his hed a flaıı̄underich bemysch hat
Hese botis clospede ful fetusely
Hese resoun he spak ful plesauntly
Sounynge alwey the cres of hese wȳnnyng
He wolde the se / were kept for ony thyng
Be twixe myddil bourgh ⁊and orewelle
Wel couthe en eschaıı̄ung schildis selle
This worthi man ful wel his wit be sette
There wiste no man that he was in dette
So estatli was he of hese goủernaıı̄unce
With hese bargaynys ⁊and hese cheuysance
Forsothe he was a worthy man withal
But sothe to seyn I not how men hȳm cal
A clerk there was of oxsenforthe alsoClek of Oxenforthe
That vnto logyk hadde longe I go
As lene was hese hors as is a rake
And he nas not / rygh fat / I vundyrtake rygh fat / I vundyrtake
